node: Advanced packaging, fan-out panel-level packaging, memory backend, and OSAT overflow
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe around AI-driven advanced-packaging and OSAT overflow. The reference lane is anchored by ASE Technology as the global OSAT scale benchmark and Amkor as the most direct US-headquartered OSAT exposure. The underfollowed lane emphasizes equipment and test bottlenecks that sit one step upstream of OSAT capacity: Kulicke & Soffa for thermocompression / advanced interconnect assembly tools and FormFactor for probe-card / test exposure to HBM and advanced packages. This pass avoids mega-cap AI leaders except as implicit demand anchors and treats the HBM-crowding-out thesis as a hypothesis requiring utilization, pricing, customer-validation, and capex evidence.
